definition_change_issues.description: Canonical policy LATEST_PRIMARY_REPORT_VERSION_WITH_EXPLICIT_RESTATEMENT_PRESERVED. Superseded 2021-report employee-average values: 2020=118765, 2021=118477. Revised 2022-report values: 2020=113350, 2021=120336, 2022=125301. Superseded values are audit context only and are not ingested as canonical observations.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: CEO total compensation under GCGC excluding fringe benefits and pension service cost
metric_definitions.definition: Source-reported GCGC total compensation excluding fringe benefits and pension service cost; not §162 paid/owed compensation.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: CEO total compensation under GCGC including fringe benefits and pension service cost
metric_definitions.definition: Source-reported GCGC total compensation including fringe benefits and pension service cost; not §162 paid/owed compensation.
Deutsche Bank CEO compensation reported under the §162 paid-or-owed / granted-and-owed reporting-year basis preserved from the source.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: CEO compensation / average employee remuneration per FTE contextual ratio
metric_definitions.definition: Contextual derived ratio: eligible full-year CEO §162 compensation divided by source-reported average employee remuneration per FTE. It is not a statutory like-for-like pay ratio.
metric_definitions.numerator_definition: Full-year CEO §162 compensation under institution-specific reporting basis.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Average employee remuneration per FTE in §162 comparison
metric_definitions.definition: Source-reported average employee remuneration per full-time equivalent used in the §162 remuneration comparison; median remuneration is a different statistic.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: ESRS S1-16 highest-paid individual / median employee remuneration ratio
metric_definitions.definition: Reported ESRS S1-16 ratio between annual total remuneration of the highest-paid individual and median annual employee remuneration; source-defined scope is preserved and not silently normalized.
metric_definitions.denominator_definition: Median annual total remuneration of employees under the reporting source definition.
metric_definitions.numerator_definition: Annual total remuneration of the highest-paid individual, as defined by the reporting source.

metric_definitions.definition: Person-specific executive compensation reported by Commerzbank under the §162 granted-and-owed / actually received-or-due reporting-year basis.
